blurb: Big Run Golf Club is an 18-hole golf course originally designed in 1930 and later redesigned by Dick Nugent. The course features hundreds of tall oak trees, five lakes, and Long Run Creek, with water coming into play on 8 of the 18 holes. It is heavily bunkered and offers a challenging and enjoyable golfing experience.
extraNote: Reservations accepted 14 days in advance · Cancellation policy is 24-hour notice · Early times on Saturdays, Sundays, and most Holidays may not be available · Rain check credits available except on Twilight Rates; half price paid if you do not start back nine; credit applies to green fees and carts only, no refunds · No coolers allowed
